decisions.reason: The waterproof lined safety range is a flagship line that builds directly on the firm's core footwear and materials know-how, so management can read its results well and keep improving it in-house.

ESD occupational shoes are a closely related extension of the firm's specialised protective footwear knowledge, and certified ESD demand from industrial customers is stable, which makes the product worth keeping and refining.

This safety shoe series fits squarely within the firm's existing competence, though as a general line it is more likely to be refreshed or replaced by newer models in a typical three-to-four-year collection cycle.
